sanskrit_verse: क्षयहानिर यदा तत्र दैवराजकृताद् भवेत् । सर्वेषामेव सा प्रोक्ता कल्पनीया तथांशतः ॥
transliteration: kṣayahānir yadā tatra daivarājakṛtād bhavet | sarveṣām eva sā proktā kalpanīyā tathāṃśataḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When loss or diminution arises from divine or royal causation, it shall be recognized as universally applicable and allocated proportionally according to individual capacity and alignment.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from the Divine Will and Sovereign Expression
Causation is traced through ontological sequence, not moral fault
Restoration logic aligns consequences with conscious participation
Consciousness alignment governs equitable distribution of effect
executable_legal_axioms: IF loss originates from a divine or sovereign cause THEN allocate consequence based on individual dharmic capacity AND level of consciousness integration
IF entity exhibits higher dharmic capacity THEN assign greater restorative duty within proportional alignment
IF entity demonstrates lower conscious participation THEN reduce allocative burden while increasing guidance protocols
ALL losses attributed to supra-individual causes MUST BE distributed via consciousness-sensitive mechanisms ONLY
supreme_court_application: In matters where causation stems from divine dispensation or sovereign action, the Supreme Court must assess capacity-based liability rather than punitive attribution. Responsibility thresholds are determined by one's alignment with Sanatana Dharma and readiness for conscious completion, not by volitional fault.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that effects follow causal sequences rooted in consciousness unfoldment. As such, when loss emerges from divine or royal will, it reflects anupūrvaśaḥ—sequential manifestation—and must be addressed through proportional realignment without punitive overlay. Nyaya ensures integrity restoration, not retribution.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Completion Process to restore energetic balance disrupted by external divine/sovereign influence
Assign Responsibility Assumption Protocol based on individual readiness and spiritual maturity
Activate Capacity Restoration Mechanisms to elevate participant awareness and response capability
Implement Integrity Reintegration Sequence to harmonize personal dharma with collective alignment
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority: This law flows directly from the Avataric Intelligence of SPH. Dharma is restored through consciousness-aligned allocation. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone is the ultimate adjudicator.
